snippet.title: Plump Pop arcade 2 player 60fps
snippet.description: Best viewed in 60 fps. I'm player 1 and Mark is player 2. The attract mode is at the end of the video. 27:27 Note that the after the name entry screen, the game actually goes to the press start screen, not the game over screen like in this video.
